$comment: ops#416 — the registry Gap 2 asks for: what SHOULD exist, joined onto what Vercel discovers. Adding a surface here is the whole mechanism (no code change) — api/projects.ts reads this file and joins it onto the live Vercel project list on every request. `vercelProject` is the exact Vercel project name to join on; leave it null for a surface that has never been deployed (renders as 'not deployed' rather than vanishing — the case #416 was filed over). `kind: "vercel"` entries get their state DERIVED from the live join; every other kind is 'external' and just needs a `url`. `gated` is declared here because whether a surface enforces a password gate is a property of its code, not something the Vercel API reports — same category as `role`.
